name: Easy-Peasy.AI
summary: All-in-one AI platform for writing, images, audio transcription, text-to-speech and chatbots, with 200+ templates, a free plan and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
best_for: solo creators, marketers and small teams that want writing, images, transcription and voice in one subscription with a free tier to try first
skip_if: you need one model with predictable pricing, only need voice output, or want a tool we have tested on a paid plan ourselves
honest_knock: Allowances are counted in model-specific words and credits, so the usable amount depends on which model you pick. The pricing page quotes a 50% and a 40% yearly discount in different places. We have not paid for a plan, so output quality is untested by us.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month billed yearly ($96 a year)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on easy-peasy.ai/pricing, US dollars) Free: $0, 1,000 words, 1 image credit, 1 transcription, 1,000 text-to-speech characters, 1 bot, 170+ templates, public images, no card. Starter: $8 a month billed yearly ($96 a year; $16 a month billed monthly), 25,000 Opus or 50,000 Sonnet, GPT-5 or Gemini Pro words, 200 image and video credits, 2 bots, 3 brand voices. Unlimited 50: $12 a month billed yearly ($144 a year; $24 monthly), unlimited standard model, 50,000 Opus or 100,000 Sonnet words, 300 credits, 3 bots. Unlimited: $16.50 a month billed yearly ($198 a year; $32 monthly), unlimited standard model, 100,000 Opus or 200,000 Sonnet words, 500 credits, 4 bots, API access, priority support. A 30-day money-back guarantee is stated. We have not paid for a plan.
